test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 23 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: For the first time in the General Elections 2024, which facility has been extended pan - India for only senior citizens and Persons with Disabilities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Home voting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The facility of **home voting** has been extended pan-India for the first time in the **General Elections 2024**.
 
• This facility is specifically designed for **senior citizens** (aged 80 years and above) and **Persons with Disabilities (PwD)**.
 
• The primary aim is to ensure that these individuals can participate in the voting process without facing the difficulties of traveling to polling stations.
 
• Election officials will visit the homes of eligible voters to collect their votes.
 
• This initiative is in line with the **Election Commission of India’s** commitment to making elections more inclusive and accessible.
 
• It also highlights the focus on **inclusivity** and **accessibility** in the electoral process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Early voting**__

 __
 
• **Early voting** allows voters to cast their ballots before the official election day.
 
• This is typically available to make voting more convenient for those who may not be able to vote on election day.
 
 
 
• **Postal voting**__
 __
 
• **Postal voting** is a method where ballots are distributed to voters and returned by post.
 
• It is often used by **overseas voters** and those who are unable to attend polling stations in person.
 
 
 
• **Online voting**__
 
 
• **Online voting** allows voters to cast their votes via the internet.
 
• It is still in the experimental stages in many countries due to **security concerns**.
